_source.title: 注册快捷键
_source.remarks.text.0: 此处注册快捷键时传入的 `shortcutKey` 仅为默认快捷键，用户可以在设置中修改
_source.remarks.text.1: 如若该快捷键与系统快捷键冲突，系统快捷键将会优先生效
_source.remarks.text.2: 如果需要修改已注册的快捷键信息，可以直接调用本接口，并在 `props` 中传入完整的需要修改的快捷键数据
_source.remarks.text.3: 本接口无法修改系统快捷键
_source.remarks.text.4: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.id: 快捷键 ID，将会自动拼接上扩展 UUID 作为前缀

title: Register shortcut key
remarks.text.0: The `shortcutKey` passed in when registering a shortcut key here is only the default shortcut key. Users can modify it in settings
remarks.text.1: If the shortcut key conflicts with a system shortcut key, the system shortcut key will take precedence
remarks.text.2: To modify registered shortcut key information, you can call this API directly and pass the complete shortcut key data to be modified in `props`
remarks.text.3: This API cannot modify system shortcut keys
remarks.text.4: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
params.id: Shortcut key ID. The extension UUID will be automatically concatenated as a prefix
